_comment: Capability: the Sunday-night week-ahead brief, surfacing the INSET day nobody registered and offering to help sort the childcare fallout while it’s still sortable.

messages.text:
Your week, the short version:

• Tue — swimming restarts, kit and goggles
• Wed — trip money deadline, £8 on ParentPay
• Fri — INSET day. No school.

Friday is the one to plan for.
September newsletter, page two, under the uniform reminders. Want a nudge tonight to sort Friday childcare while everyone’s still awake?
Even better. I’ll check back at 9 in case Grandma has plans.
